items.text: As part of regular protocol after travel, I tested for COVID-19 this morning & got a positive result (after testing negative earlier this week). Thanks to protections from being vaccinated & boosted, I'm grateful to only be experiencing mild symptoms.

In the past 2+yrs, we’ve had unique challenges & stress from COVID, & the necessity of good, quality sleep has become more glaring.

During #SleepAwarenessWeek, as Co-Chair of the Sleep Health Caucus, I encourage more sleep research.

Sleep science info: https://t.co/75cC8qSHfA

I’m thrilled that we'll see a new quiet zone in San Jose starting TODAY.

By implementing changes at multiple Warm Springs railroad crossings, we'll be protecting public safety while allowing residents in Japantown & other communities to get the good sleep they deserve. https://t.co/c4Sn5dWyWA

For over 25 years, Drug Courts & Veterans Treatment Courts have reduced crime, saved billions of tax dollars, & helped over 1.5 million Americans on the path to long-term recovery.

My Treatment Court, Rehabilitation, and Recovery Act will build on that success.

#DrugCourtMonth https://t.co/n9weflWa8f

The evidence is clear: dental health is strongly related to overall health.
 
I joined @RepLloydDoggett & @RepBarragan in urging Medicare to cover all medically necessary dental care for seniors.

https://t.co/8ucQZBJTch

Thanks to the #InflationReductionAct, over 23,000 CA19 residents will save an average of $1,200 in health insurance premiums.
 
5,000 CA19 Medicare recipients will also have the cost of their insulin capped at $35 per month. https://t.co/FTHvWQYE2w

I support CA's new school start times. Sleep is vital to students’ physical & mental health & academic performance.

I reintro'd the ZZZ’s to A’s Act so that schools across the country have the tools they need to make informed decisions about start times.

https://t.co/i5bdf1zbgq

I'm very disappointed by the 5th Circuit's ruling. DACA is a lawful exercise of discretion. However, this ruling is an important reminder that the Senate needs to act ASAP to deliver permanent protections for all dreamers.
 
The Senate needs to pass the Dream & Promise Act.
I’m so proud to stand with vital health care workers & the patients who receive lifesaving treatment at dialysis centers.

Mayor Kimbley Craig & I met right after learning we secured two pots of federal funding for the Salinas Wastewater Treatment Facility.

💵 $2.5M+ to fix site damages
💵 $960K to expand the facility

We’ll keep working to bring home investments that help the Salinas Valley! https://t.co/j4abnVBrDl

I recently welcomed leaders from @WatsonvilleCity to discuss local infrastructure needs & how we can foster economic development in the region.

I was especially eager to share that the Watsonville Wastewater Treatment Facility will soon receive nearly $1M in federal funding. https://t.co/wOUZuydeIt

Early school start times often don’t allow teens to get the sleep they need to stay healthy & succeed.

My family experienced this firsthand. I reintro’d my ZZZ’s to A’s Act, which examines school start times & builds on state-based efforts federally.

https://t.co/qYwHPiU3yG https://t.co/uyoiEGIeRr

Just weeks ago, Republicans voted for a
budget that requires Medicaid &
nutrition cuts to pay for tax handouts for billionaires.
 Now, after walking away from bipartisan
gov funding negotiations, they offer a
partisan bill that slashes $$ for veterans’
benefits, affordable housing, health care, flood protection projects, & more.

Why would Senate Democrats vote for the partisan Republican CR & defund veterans’ health care (PACT Act)?

We need some spine & leadership!

Today, I joined @repliccardo, local leaders, drs, & patients to raise our voices against the ever-building threats to Medicaid (Medi-Cal in CA).

Nearly 325,000 people in CA-18 are at risk of losing their health care under Republicans’ plans. It's shameful.

Watch the event here⤵️
https://t.co/SRRaZePVmw

Community Health Centers, like Dientes Community Dental Care, provide necessary services to low-income or rural communities.

Cuts to Medicaid / Medi-Cal threaten their ability to serve our communities. https://t.co/K2x9EcrHrc

Families who are focused on their child’s cancer treatment should not have to worry about anything else, like rising costs & cuts to Medicaid.

I was glad to tour @jacobsheart facilities to see how they support children battling cancer, & their families, while receiving treatment.
